hints.title: Bitmask Compression for Words
hints.text: Since character order does not matter and puzzle length is exactly 7, compress words into 26-bit integers.

hints.title: Filter Words with Excess Letters
hints.text: Words with more than 7 unique characters can never be subsets of a 7-character puzzle, so they can be discarded.

hints.title: Puzzle Submask Iteration
hints.text: The puzzle first character bit must always be set. Iterate over all 2^6 = 64 submasks of the remaining 6 puzzle characters and sum their word frequencies.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all word-puzzle pairs naively takes quadratic O(W * P * L) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterating over all 64 submasks of each puzzle takes constant 2^6 steps per puzzle.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that 7-letter puzzles suggest submask iteration over 2^6 combinations.
complexity.notes: First letter of puzzle is mandatory for every matching word.
